title: Pulse local declarative package registry v1
description: Maintainer contract for registry.json; manage it through pulse-ext, not by editing it. The host additionally enforces a 64 KiB UTF-8 limit, decoded UTF-8 string byte limits, unique package IDs, content hashes and enabled manifest identity. This is not a publisher identity or authorization scheme.

name.description: Nonblank display name; at most 128 decoded UTF-8 bytes, enforced by the host.

revision.description: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 manifest bytes; relative blob location is versions/<revision>.json. Never a filesystem path supplied by the package.
